flags.issue: Call observation dates = 'each coupon observation date ... commencing January 2027' with no exclusion of the final date, so the determination date is treated as callable literally (19 levels = obs 2..20). Economically equivalent at the final date; verify convention.
Strike date July 14, 2026 differs from trade date July 15, 2026; initial levels are strike-date closes and are stated to be higher than trade-date closes.
Coupon quoted as '$0.25/qtr. (up to 10.00% per annum)'; 'up to' wording is odd, but 10.00%/4 = 2.50% = $0.25/$10, consistent.
Ticker field filled from Bloomberg Symbol ('SX5E Index', 'NDX Index') with ' Index' suffix stripped; names contain spaced ® as in cleaned text.
Dates subject to postponement; scheduled dates used as printed. Several dates shifted off the 14th (e.g. 2028-04-18, 2028-10-16, 2029-01-16).

scope.reason: Worst-of two equity price indices (SX5E, NDX), quarterly contingent non-memory coupon, discrete quarterly autocall at 100% from obs 2, European 70% downside threshold with 1:1 loss; fits the pricing template.
